description: Parse an ISO 20022 camt.054 debit / credit notification (versions .001.02 to .001.08, one XML or a ZIP of up to 20) into one record per payment: every collective entry (Swiss QR-bill credits, SEPA batch credits, direct debit collections) is unpacked into its transactions and checked (sum of the transactions = booked amount). Each transaction has dates, signed amount, counterparty name / IBAN / BIC, structured reference with its check (QR reference mod 10, RF creditor reference ISO 11649), remittance text, EndToEndId, mandate, bank codes and charges. Optional output as CSV or as a DATEV EXTF v700 Buchungsstapel (base64). Up to 1,000 transactions per call. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/camt054-to-excel.

clientNo.description: DATEV Mandantennummer for the file header (optional)

consultantNo.description: DATEV Beraternummer for the file header (optional)

csvSeparator.description: CSV separator; ';' writes a decimal comma

fileContent.description: Or the .xml / the bank's .zip base64-encoded (max 12 MB per XML)

output.description: json = records only; csv / datev also return the file as base64 in outputFiles

xml.description: The camt.054 file as XML text (empty = built-in sample: 6 payments, 3 entries)
